screening.reason: Documented example could not complete because the required Zenodo benchmark archive was unreachable. The original upstream fetch stalled, and the single allowed compatibility retry using the canonical Zenodo record URL also stalled before receiving data.

The documented synthetic experiment completed successfully in 474.06 seconds, exceeding the frozen corpus default validation timeout of 300 seconds. No repository-specific timeout had been predeclared, so the baseline is ineligible.

After the single allowed compatibility retry (pinning typeguard 2.11.1 for the repository-era pytest stack), the documented upstream test workflow failed during collection because torch_sparse and torch_geometric were unavailable. These dependencies are not installed by the documented requirements/main-package setup; no further dependency archaeology was attempted.

The documented example completed successfully. Post-hoc semantic verification confirmed that changing np.random.seed from 123 to 124 changed all 600 generated synthetic scalar values and changed downstream cluster assignments, while the documented workflow still completed.

The documented Autorank example completed successfully after changing np.random.seed from 42 to 43. Post-hoc semantic verification confirmed a non-equivalent mutation: 279 of 300 generated scalar values changed, the Friedman-test p-value changed from 2.3412212612346733e-28 to 4.012341280950854e-26, and downstream mean ranks changed.

The documented MUTAG experiment completed successfully after changing the executed outer StratifiedKFold from 10 to 11 folds. Post-hoc semantic verification confirmed a non-equivalent evaluation protocol: fold count changed from 10 to 11, test-set sizes changed, and the first held-out partition changed.

The upstream-documented editable documentation setup, python -m pip install -e .[docs,all_features], exceeded the frozen 300-second timeout while downloading declared dependencies. Baseline and mutation validation were not run under the baseline-first rule.

semantic_verification.evidence: Changing the seed changed all generated factor entries (A: 90/90, B: 120/120, C: 60/60), all 24,000 noise values, and all 24,000 synthesized tensor values; SHA-256 digests differed for every artifact.
semantic_verification.method: Post-hoc replayed the example's synthetic factor, noise, and tensor construction with seeds 0 and 1 and compared element counts and SHA-256 digests; this was not used as the primary oracle.

semantic_verification.method: Post-hoc instantiated the example model under both seeds and compared all state_dict tensors and digests; this was not used as the primary oracle.
